scripts.build:dependencies: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm --filter @vite-electron-simple/plugin --filter @vite-electron-simple/common build
scripts.publish:patch: pnpm build && pnpm -r version patch && pnpm -r publish
scripts.publish:minor: pnpm build && pnpm -r version minor && pnpm -r publish
scripts.publish:major: pnpm build && pnpm -r version major && pnpm -r publish
